summary_text: In April 2026, one order of Flipkart Supermart Scrub Sponge Medium (Pack of 2) was placed on a weekend afternoon. This timing aligns with the population baseline, where afternoon shares (0.2526) are lower than morning (0.3246) and evening (0.3027), but represent a common window for household maintenance tasks. The product is a utility-oriented cleaning accessory intended for routine scrubbing. This is a single observation on one date. It is not yet established whether this brand or product type represents a stable preference or a one-time replacement need. No other brands or product variants have been observed in this category to determine brand loyalty or category breadth.
